_comment: Schools whose NFHS Network slug cannot be derived from the name. The harvester matches strictly - every distinctive word of the school name must appear as a whole hyphen-separated word in the slug, and no slug may serve two schools - so it refuses rather than guessing, and what it refuses is listed here. Resolve each against the sitemap and pick by event-card count when two records compete. null means the school is genuinely not on NFHS Network.

_notes.Warren Hills vs Watchung Hills: These two sit in each other's towns - Warren Hills Regional is in WASHINGTON, Watchung Hills Regional is in WARREN - and a search for either returns both. Swapping them would publish one school's games on the other's page.
_notes.Bernards vs Gill St. Bernard's: 'bernards' matches both; Gill St. Bernard's is in Gladstone and NFHS writes it 'gillst-bernards'.
_notes.Franklin: Franklin HS is in Somerset. The other candidate, Ramapo, is in Franklin LAKES and is a Big North school.
_notes.Ridge: Five slugs contain 'ridge'. Ridge High School is in Basking Ridge; Park Ridge, Glen Ridge and Oak Ridge are different schools entirely.
_notes.Voorhees: Voorhees HS is in Glen Gardner. Eastern Regional is in the TOWN of Voorhees, in South Jersey.
_notes.H.S. abbreviation: Seven of this conference's school names end in 'H.S.' rather than 'High School', which is why so many needed an override here compared with other conferences.
